title: Pardes me zainab kho baithi
body:
Pardes me zainab kho baithi atthaara baras ke paale ko
rote hai khade sab aale nabi atthaara baras ke paale ko
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan na nikla bano ka , hai laash pe nouha bano ka
paayegi kahaa'n ye kookh jali,atthaara baras ke paale ko
<<DIVIDER>>
dil thaam ke akbar ki maadar, sarwar se ye kehti hai rokar
kho aaye kahaa'n ae ibe ali , atthaara baras ke paale ko
<<DIVIDER>>
naazo'n se muraado'n se paala, shaadi ki zamaana jab aaya
maidaan me kho kar baith gayi, atthaara baras ke paale ko
<<DIVIDER>>
qismat ka karoo'n mai kis se gila, qidmat ka iwaz kuch bhi na mila
sehra bhi na zainab baandh saki, atthaara baras ke paale ko
<<DIVIDER>>
shoukat ye qayaamat ka gham hai , shoukat ye ghazab ka maatam hai
baali pa khadi rote hai nabi, atthaara baras ke paale ko
